description: This file implements Text-to-Speech (TTS) functionality, including configuration resolution, provider management, speech synthesis, telephony support, voice listing, and TTS directive parsing within the openclaw plugin SDK.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredTtsAutoMode
methods.description: Resolves the auto mode setting from TtsConfig, defaulting to 'always' if enabled, otherwise 'off'.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredSpeechProviderId
methods.description: Normalizes a speech provider ID, mapping 'edge' to 'microsoft'.

methods.name: resolveTtsPrefsPathValue
methods.description: Determines the preferences file path for TTS, considering environment variables and default locations.

methods.name: resolveModelOverridePolicy
methods.description: Resolves the policy for model overrides in TTS configuration.

methods.name: sortSpeechProvidersForAutoSelection
methods.description: Sorts available speech providers based on auto-selection order.

methods.name: resolveRegistryDefaultSpeechProviderId
methods.description: Gets the default speech provider ID based on registry sorting.

methods.name: asProviderConfig
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a SpeechProviderConfig object.

methods.name: asProviderConfigMap
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a map of provider configurations.

methods.name: resolveRawProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves raw provider configuration for a specific provider ID.

methods.name: resolveLazyProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves provider configuration lazily, resolving provider-specific configs.

methods.name: collectDirectProviderConfigEntries
methods.description: Collects direct provider configuration entries from raw TTS config.

methods.name: getResolvedSpeechProviderConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the resolved configuration for a specific speech provider.

methods.name: resolveTtsConfig
methods.description: Resolves the complete TTS configuration from the given OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: resolveTtsPrefsPath
methods.description: Returns the preferences path for TTS based on resolved config.

methods.name: resolveTtsAutoModeFromPrefs
methods.description: Determines TTS auto mode from user preferences.

methods.name: resolveTtsAutoMode
methods.description: Resolves the effective TTS auto mode considering config, preferences, and session auto.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveTtsAutoState
methods.description: Determines the effective TTS auto mode and preferences path.

methods.name: buildTtsSystemPromptHint
methods.description: Builds a system prompt hint string for TTS based on current configuration.

methods.name: readPrefs
methods.description: Reads user preferences from the specified path.

methods.name: atomicWriteFileSync
methods.description: Writes content atomically to a file.

methods.name: updatePrefs
methods.description: Updates user preferences with a provided update function.

methods.name: isTtsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TTS is enabled based on config and preferences.

methods.name: setTtsAutoMode
methods.description: Sets the TTS auto mode in user preferences.

methods.name: setTtsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS via preferences.

methods.name: getTtsProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the current TTS provider based on preferences and config.

methods.name: setTtsProvider
methods.description: Sets the TTS provider in user preferences.

methods.name: getTtsMaxLength
methods.description: Gets the maximum TTS text length from preferences.

methods.name: setTtsMaxLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum TTS text length in preferences.

methods.name: isSummarizationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TTS summarization is enabled in preferences.

methods.name: setSummarizationEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS summarization in preferences.

methods.name: getLastTtsAttempt
methods.description: Returns the last TTS attempt status entry.

methods.name: setLastTtsAttempt
methods.description: Sets the last TTS attempt status entry.

methods.name: resolveChannelId
methods.description: Resolves a channel string to a ChannelId object.

methods.name: resolveTtsProviderOrder
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of TTS providers starting with the primary.

methods.name: isTtsProviderConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a specific TTS provider is properly configured.

methods.name: formatTtsProviderError
methods.description: Formats an error message for a TTS provider error.

methods.name: sanitizeTtsErrorForLog
methods.description: Sanitizes error messages for logging, removing sensitive info.

methods.name: buildTtsFailureResult
methods.description: Builds a failure result object for TTS failures.

methods.name: resolveReadySpeechProvider
methods.description: Resolves a speech provider and checks if it is ready for use.

methods.name: resolveTtsRequestSetup
methods.description: Prepares TTS request setup, including configuration and provider order.

methods.name: textToSpeech
methods.description: Performs TTS conversion, returning audio file path and metadata.

methods.name: synthesizeSpeech
methods.description: Synthesizes speech audio buffer from text using configured providers.

methods.name: listSpeechVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a speech provider.

methods.name: maybeApplyTtsToPayload
methods.description: Applies TTS to a reply payload if auto mode and directives permit.
